issue_text: I was charged twice for my February subscription
resolution_text: Refunded the duplicate charge and confirmed single billing going forward.

issue_text: My invoice shows an amount I don't recognize
resolution_text: Reviewed the invoice line items and issued a credit for the discrepancy.

issue_text: The discount code I used wasn't applied at checkout
resolution_text: Manually applied the discount code and adjusted the charge.

issue_text: I'm being billed after I cancelled my plan
resolution_text: Confirmed cancellation date and refunded the post-cancellation charge.

issue_text: My payment method was charged in the wrong currency
resolution_text: Corrected the currency setting on the account and refunded the difference.

issue_text: The app crashes every time I open the settings screen
resolution_text: Identified a bug in the profile screen and shipped a patch in the next release.

issue_text: I can't upload files larger than a few MB
resolution_text: Increased the upload size limit and confirmed the fix on the user's account.

issue_text: The dashboard is stuck loading and never finishes
resolution_text: Cleared a stuck background job that was blocking the dashboard from loading.

issue_text: Push notifications stopped working after the last update
resolution_text: Reset notification permissions and reinstalled the push service on the user's device.

issue_text: The search feature returns no results for anything I type
resolution_text: Rebuilt the search index, which had become corrupted after a migration.

issue_text: I'm locked out of my account after too many login attempts
resolution_text: Manually unlocked the account after verifying identity.

issue_text: The password reset email never arrives
resolution_text: Resent the reset email after confirming the address on file was correct.

issue_text: Two-factor authentication codes aren't being accepted
resolution_text: Resynced the two-factor authenticator and issued new backup codes.

issue_text: My account shows someone else's information
resolution_text: Identified an account merge error and restored the correct profile data.

issue_text: I can't log in even with the correct password
resolution_text: Reset the password directly after verifying identity through support.

issue_text: My order hasn't arrived and tracking hasn't updated in 4 days
resolution_text: Contacted the carrier, confirmed the delay, and issued a partial credit.

issue_text: I received the wrong item in my order
resolution_text: Shipped the correct item at no extra cost and arranged return of the wrong one.

issue_text: The package arrived damaged
resolution_text: Processed a replacement and filed a damage claim with the carrier.

issue_text: My order shows delivered but I never received it
resolution_text: Filed a lost-package investigation with the carrier and reshipped the order.

issue_text: I need to change my shipping address after placing the order
resolution_text: Updated the shipping address before the fulfillment cutoff.

issue_text: I want to cancel my subscription but can't find the option
resolution_text: Walked the user through the cancellation flow and confirmed it was completed.

issue_text: I requested a refund 11 days ago and haven't heard back
resolution_text: Located the pending refund request and processed it same-day.

issue_text: I was charged after I thought I cancelled
resolution_text: Investigated the cancellation timestamp and refunded the erroneous charge.

issue_text: The refund I received was less than what I paid
resolution_text: Corrected the refund amount to match the original charge.

issue_text: I want to cancel and get a refund for this month
resolution_text: Processed the cancellation and a pro-rated refund for the current month.
